apps.name: K3 Browser
apps.subtitle: Native WKWebView browser baseline
apps.localizedDescription: Native iOS WKWebView browser for sideloading. No DDG entitlements, no extensions, no app groups. Includes Hermes-Lite browser runtime: observe page, reason with AI, parse tool-call JSON, approve risky browser actions, execute WKWebView tools, log every step, save memory notes, and export results.
apps.versionDescription: Hermes-Lite GLM preset fix: defaults to Z.AI GLM 5.2 chat completions endpoint, auto-normalizes /v4 endpoints to /chat/completions, and adds Use GLM 5.2 preset button.
